title: Mask Adoption Behavior Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under the influence of social networks, policies, enforcement, media messaging, costs, and individual traits.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers’ mask use in their social network and adjust their own adoption probability via a threshold or weighted influence rule.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Mask mandates at locations increase agents’ compliance probability; enforcement actions occur with some probability based on enforcement strength and resources.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: HealthAuthority and MediaOutlet broadcast messages affecting risk perception and trust; persons update beliefs based on source credibility and prior trust.

interactions.name: economic_access
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from store-type locations if affordable and available; price and income determine access.

interactions.name: contextual_exposure_signal
interactions.description: Exogenous or model-generated risk signals (e.g., perceived disease prevalence) alter risk perception and thus adoption propensity.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption fraction at the end of the observation period.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption first exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration_above_threshold
metrics.description: Total days adoption remains above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Adoption rates segmented by location type (home, work, school, transport, stores).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Variance or Gini coefficient of adoption across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to mandates or campaigns (e.g., difference-in-differences pre/post intervention).

metrics.name: both_masked_contact_share
metrics.description: Share of interactions where both participants are masked (proxy for risk reduction).

metrics.name: adoption_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals switch between wearing and not wearing masks.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_per_day
metrics.description: Number of enforcement events (warnings/fines) per day.
